findings.detail: First runnable journey is `python3 -m deponent.badge verify --kernel deponent`. Stranger cannot get a receipt without Deponent. Contradicts mission first-run.
`Score your own kernel` is four prose steps with no in-repo command and implies the Deponent harness (spec §7.1).
Imports deponent.badge / deponent.conformance. Mission names this coupling as a defect: harness must live in this repo.
§1 and §7.1 present Deponent as the reference harness (`from deponent.conformance import run_conformance`). Product face must not copy that ownership.
Status leads with v1.1 as current. v0 ships frozen gak-conformance/v1 (13 clauses).
Honest line `Third-party verdicts to date: zero` is correct and must be preserved.

A web UI, badge gallery, or kernel directory is required for v0.
v1.1 (14th clause) is the v0 ship surface.

open_risks: python3 -m gak_conformance on a raw clone needs a packaging/path decision; a hidden PYTHONPATH breaks first-use clarity.
Fixture adapters that return correct answers are simulations; legal only as selfcheck, never as a published certification.
CLI --adapter module:Class is Python-centric (acceptable for v0; do not claim language-neutral CLI).
Fabricated adapters cannot be fully detected; void-claim language is the trust control.
Half-updated docs that still show deponent.badge as the GAK command will split the product in two.
